description: Main plugin index file for the MiniMax provider, setting up provider registration, OAuth handling, and related configurations.

methods.name: resolveMinimaxReasoningOutputMode
methods.description: Returns 'native' to keep MiniMax on native reasoning mode.

methods.name: getDefaultBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the default base URL depending on the region ('cn' or global).

methods.name: apiModelRef
methods.description: Constructs a model reference string for API models.

methods.name: portalModelRef
methods.description: Constructs a model reference string for portal models.

methods.name: buildPortalProviderCatalog
methods.description: Builds a portal provider catalog object with baseUrl and apiKey.

methods.name: resolveApiCatalog
methods.description: Resolves the API provider catalog based on API key availability.

methods.name: resolvePortalCatalog
methods.description: Resolves the portal provider catalog, considering explicit config, environment, and profiles.

methods.name: createOAuthHandler
methods.description: Creates an OAuth handler function for a given region ('cn' or global).
